Package index

Checks

Check a data set against its specification.

ysx_check()
Check a data set against its specification with extra checks
ysx_check_missing()
Check missing values against a specification
ysx_check_repeats()
Check the number of rows in each group

Groups

Set or remove the columns that define groups.

ysx_regroup()
Replace the group columns of a specification
ysx_ungroup()
Remove the group columns of a specification

Build and edit specifications

df_to_yspec()
Convert a data frame to a yspec yaml file
ys_sort_spec_vars()
Sort specification variables to match a data frame
ys_write()
Write a yspec object to a YAML file
ysx_load_pkpdspec()
Load the bundled PK/PD (NONMEM) specification

Use specifications

ysx_factors()
Convert columns to factors with specification-controlled ordering
ysx_plt_relab()
Relabel plot titles, legends and facet strips from a specification
